# Jyotirmoy Barman — Senior Software Developer

> Personal portfolio and engineering showcase

## About

Jyotirmoy Barman is a senior software developer focused on full-stack engineering, scalable architecture, and product delivery across modern web and cloud platforms.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jewel998.github.io/): Portfolio landing page with hero, expertise, and contact sections
- [About](https://jewel998.github.io/about/): Experience, skills, and engineering background
- [Projects](https://jewel998.github.io/projects/): Showcase of open-source and production projects
- [Contact](https://jewel998.github.io/contact/): Get in touch for collaborations and opportunities

## Projects

- [Config Platform](https://github.com/jewel998/config): Multi-tenant configuration platform with Firebase and VitePress docs
- [State Machine](https://github.com/jewel998/state-machine): Type-safe stateless state machine library for JS/TS, published on npm
- [SKU Label Maker](https://github.com/jewel998/sku): PWA React label maker with PDF generation
- [Portfolio Website](https://github.com/jewel998/jewel998.github.io): React + TanStack Router + Tailwind CSS v4 + i18n
- [Lyrics Music Player](https://github.com/jewel998/playlist): Web-based music player with real-time lyrics sync

## Tech Stack

React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Router, Motion, Firebase, AWS, GCP, Prisma, Fastify
